question: Which thirty-two outward-going gods and which deity occupy the navel and back region?
premises: Thirty-two gods are described as outside-going.
Brahmā is situated at the navel and back.
inference: The vāstu body includes thirty-two exterior deities with Brahmā positioned at the navel and back.
plain_english: There are thirty-two outward-going gods, and Brahmā is situated at the navel and back.
